items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: you and Marl Marie Young were talking

ctx.x: Yeah, so, Stuff Smith was quite a -- he was something.

Last night at the meeting -- after the meeting of the Jazz Heritage Foundation board, you and Marl Marie Young were talking and one of the stories you were telling was about how the Stuff Smith Trio didn't get drafted and why, during World War II.
Oh, okay. Well, Stuff had -- well, he wasn't dangerously insane or anything like that, but he had just come out of -- Kankakee, Illinois, you know.
